notes.title: Convenient: The Graveyard Update is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=De4hdVZuoHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42917945/d65681330218b9663f8947c2dbf9afc974aaeaf5.png[/img]

There has always been more than meets the eye in Oldlake. Dig deeper into the mystery of cryptids you encounter there in the Graveyard Update! Explore 2 new areas filled with puzzles to solve, enemies to avoid, and secrets to find.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42917945/26491301409b83033cc0f484b9f7568d5abe1ec8.gif[/img]

Discover more with 3 new VHS tapes filled with lore and secrets. Each VHS will trigger events around you. Find out what each of them means and connect the dots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42917945/7b72cadc92d5c6e79a2e1dc7e2508dc8d0afa51b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42917945/52f456932ec17b1da02a6d784569a1b267e90208.png[/img]

Avoid the Spirit and Priest in The Graveyard. With 2 new areas comes more danger lurking in every corner. While solving puzzles, avoid any contact with these entities. Don't even look at them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42917945/afc2aa1f3a36e15c0e575683dd495ab657353964.gif[/img]

notes.title: Convenient v928 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Made some quick bugs fixes because some players were getting stuck or experiencing glitches. Thank you to everyone who reported these bugs, you've helped make the game better!

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]
- You can now only drink the water once per life
- Interacting with the VCR without a VHS no longer resets VCR
- Interaction with batteries is reset on death
- "TAB >" text under items only shows if you have more than 1 item in inventory
- Pressing the 'ESC' button no longer softlocks
- other minor fixes

notes.title: Convenient Inventory Update
notes.notes:
This is the first content update since [b]Convenient[/b]'s release that not only fixes many bugs but adds quality of life features like an inventory system.

[h2]How Inventory Works[/h2]
When you [b]pick up[/b] an item it goes into your inventory, which you will see at the bottom of your screen. Press the [b]TAB key to switch[/b] items.

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]
- Added [b]Inventory System[/b]
- Cashier now runs and walks faster
- fixed bug where [b]multiple items[/b] are held in hand at once
- fixed [b]creature scream[/b] sound triggering multiple times 
- fixed player [b]falling through ground[/b] when pressing 'retry'
- added a trigger below map that [b]teleports player[/b] back to the top if they fall through
- you no longer [b]shoot gun[/b] when interacting with items
- [b]many[/b] other minor bug fixes

I would also like to thank everyone for supporting the game so far. The support has been unexpectedly massive and I'm glad so many people are enjoying it and providing feedback. If you have more features you want added or bugs fixed, reach out and let me know. Thank you!
